The criminal facts are rock-solid: Milton was convicted at trial in October 2022 on one count of securities fraud and two counts of wire fraud, and sentenced December 18, 2023 by Judge Ramos (SDNY) to four years in prison. A four-year term imposed in December 2023 would not expire until roughly December 2027, so absent intervening events Milton would be mid-sentence on 2026-10-01. The claim fails only because of two reported intervening facts: he was free on bail pending appeal the whole time, and President Trump reportedly pardoned him in late March 2025. No primary source has been checked: no Bureau of Prisons record, no White House/DOJ pardon record, no court docket. If the pardon reporting were wrong, the pardon were revoked or legally ineffective, or the Second Circuit had affirmed and ordered surrender to custody, 'currently serving' would be TRUE.
